evaluation.primary_unit: one query packet under a fixed serialized-content budget
evaluation.mandatory_coverage: For each query, fraction of its mandatory card IDs retrieved; also report exact-span coverage separately when the emitted packet contains enough text to intersect each annotated inclusive line span. Aggregate micro-averaged across 12 queries and macro-averaged by query.
evaluation.packet_bytes: UTF-8 byte length of the exact serialized packet, including packet header/trailer; report per query and mean. Never treat a soft budget overrun as compliant.
evaluation.packet_tokens: Count the same exact serialized packet using one frozen tokenizer/version recorded with results (prefer o200k_base); report per query and mean. If unavailable, report null rather than relabel bytes as tokens.
evaluation.scope_preservation: Secondary binary checklist per task for answer_requirements, judged against the cited source spans; do not score mathematical truth or novelty.
evaluation.budget_rule: Run each system at the same per-query maximum of 6000 UTF-8 bytes and 1500 tokens; stop packing at the first constraint reached. Report actual bytes and tokens, with headers/trailers included.
evaluation.baseline: Generic lexical BM25 over the same card corpus (all card text, no curated alias routing, no preselected query-specific card list), top-ranked passage packing under exactly the same byte/token constraints. Freeze BM25 implementation, tokenizer, analyzer and tie-break by card ID in the run record. This is the equal-information-budget baseline; compare systems at identical ceilings and report realized packet sizes.
evaluation.no_gold_leakage: Gold IDs/spans stay outside query input and retrieval index metadata visible to systems; evaluate only after packets are frozen.
